newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus Popular to manage Fidelity Funds.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus Popular to manage Fidelity Funds.

text.p: The Cyprus Popular Bank on Monday announced the launch of 31 different funds offered by Fidelity Investments on the island.

The Popular Bank, Cyprus's second largest, will promote 31 of the 335 funds Fidelity offers, each relating to a separate portfolio of securities, bank chairman Kikis Lazarides told a news conference on Monday.

"The Popular Bank will benefit from the vast experience and knowledge of Fidelity in the world markets, (and) enrich our product portfolio, utilise more efficiently our customer base and take advantage of Fidelity's expertise in marketing, training and technology," said Lazarides.
Under terms of the agreement the Popular Bank becomes the only institution in Cyprus with the right to market Fidelity Funds locally.
The minimum amount that can be invested in a Fidelity Fund is $2,500, and $1,000 for any additional investment.
Popular Bank will also be offering managed portfolios, funds tailor-made to suit the requirement of customers that will reflect their specific risk-return preferences, Lazarides said.
The minimum amount that can be invested in managed portfolios is $30,000, and $5,000 for any additional investment.

Under present Central Bank restrictions on foreign exchange eligible institutional and private investors that can invest are restricted to offshore and overseas companies, non-resident individuals and repatriated Cypriots.
Lazarides said there will be more opportunities to offer new products and services to Cypriot investors once exchange controls are lifted.
